customer_recount: The caller received a flier about the internet advantage plan and wanted to know what it was and what it included. The caller also inquired about deals on TV services. The agent explained the difference between the internet advantage and the caller's current internet speed and offered the caller the option to try the TV package with a 30-day money back guarantee. The agent also mentioned the possibility of a mobile contract buyout, but the caller decided to hold off and call back later.

The caller wants to delete one of their UH-3 phone lines from their account. The agent verified the caller's account and found three lines. The caller wanted to disconnect line 0952. The agent informed the caller that the line will be charged to the end of the billing cycle and will be deactivated at the end of the cycle. The agent also informed the caller that if the line is brought back after 30 days, it can be brought back for free for a whole year.

The caller lost their promotional discount and is inquiring about any specials or discounts that could lower their bill. The agent checked for promotions and discounts but found none. The agent suggested the caller to speak to the caller Solutions department to see if they could apply a specialized test offer. The agent also helped the caller pay their bill using an AARP credit card. However, the agent was unable to find any promotions or discounts.

The caller is experiencing an issue with their internet connection in [ADDRESS]. The agent identified that there was an outage in the caller's area due to maintenance work. The service was expected to be back up around [DATE_TIME]. The agent was able to credit the caller's account for the outage, which would appear on their next monthly statement.

The caller is having trouble with a ticket and a representative is refusing to come to their new address because the provider made a mistake and sent them to their old address. The agent confirmed the caller's new address and arranged for a representative to visit the caller's old address between [DATE_TIME] and [DATE_TIME]. The agent apologized for the confusion and assured the caller that they would do their best to resolve the issue.

The caller called to inquire about a charge of $193.58 on their bank statement and to understand why they were being charged for their service. The agent found that the caller's account was suspended due to lack of payment and found that the caller had two active accounts, one under their name and one under another person's name. The agent explained that the caller could pay the remaining balance to reactivate the services and free up the phones. The caller decided to check with the other person to see if they could free up the phones before making the payment.

The caller inquired about the breakdown of their bill and the expiration date of their promotion. The agent checked the caller's service address, found that their TV stream and internet speed are active until [DATE_TIME], and their monthly bill is a flat $80.00.
I have been a customer for decades and now on a fixed income in retirement and would appreciate a senior cost reduction even if it meant less channels

The caller is experiencing frequent Wi-Fi disconnections, even after receiving a new router a few weeks ago. The agent verified the caller's address and checked the modem's signals. A technician was scheduled to visit the caller's home between [DATE_TIME] and [DATE_TIME]. The caller was advised to have someone [AGE] old or older answer the door and to put away any pets for the technician's safety. The caller also inquired about returning a new router, and the agent informed them that it could be returned to inventory by the technician.

All my tv does is "buffer". I have called many times and nothing ever gets better. I'm disabled and this is my only entertainment. I have been your customer for over seven years and nothing ever gets better. It's my opinion no one really cares just like this.
I love the provider but the prices keep going up! I am almost at the point of get an outside antenna.
"My TV just quits getting a signal a couple times a day. And you keep raising the rates. I am going to check with AT&T for a better rate."

The caller wants to schedule a serviceability appointment. The agent validated the caller's residential address and informed them that the first available appointment is on the [DATE_TIME] or later. The caller agreed to schedule the appointment.

The caller was unable to pay their bill through the automated system as it did not recognize their routing number on their bank account. The agent verified the caller's identity and found that the payment method had to be on file. The agent set up the caller's account and payment method, waived the activation fee, and provided a confirmation number for future payments. The agent also informed the caller about the grace period and the possibility of changing payment methods in the future.
Pretty good services but need to reduce the tv bills

The caller needs to connect a coaxial cable to their home internet but does not have a available connection. The agent confirmed the caller's address and arranged for a technician to install the service for them. The appointment was scheduled for the next day between [DATE_TIME] and [DATE_TIME]. The caller was advised to secure any pets and to inform the technician of the location of the cable installation.

The caller was experiencing issues with their internet while on vacation in [ADDRESS] and was billed for a full amount despite being unable to access their internet. They believe they should not have been billed for the full amount if they were not able to access their internet during this period. The agent checked the caller's account and found no changes or work orders related to the issue. The agent suggested transferring the caller to the tech support team for a verified credit to investigate the issue.

The caller is unable to access certain channels like Netflix, HBO, and peacock after installing their cable. The agent informed the caller that Netflix is not part of the provider and suggested signing up for the channels on the provider.net. The caller expressed frustration as they were [AGE] old and had not received assistance. The agent scheduled an appointment for an agent to help with the issue and informed the caller that they would receive a text when the appointment was scheduled.
friendly knowledgeable personnel

The caller is experiencing an internet outage and VPN connection issues after a router replacement. The agent found that the caller's static IP was not configured in the router and added it. The agent also disabled the firewall in the router and suggested rebooting the Fortinet or other devices trying to connect the VPN. The agent also mentioned that the caller' agent had been instructed to factory reset their equipment, but the caller was concerned that this might have caused the issue. The agent recommended keeping the ticket open for further troubleshooting.

The caller, an RCS representative, called to inquire about getting the same day next day for an installation. The agent, [NAME], verified the caller's information and found available dates for the next day. The caller chose the time of [DATE_TIME]. The agent then modified the caller's pending order to a same day, next day free pro installation and scheduled it for the next day at [DATE_TIME] in The evening.

The caller's internet and landline services are down after a technician installed a phone for their service. The agent confirmed that the landline was not working and that the caller had already reset the modem. The agent then escalated the issue to the support team for further troubleshooting.

The caller had two issues: 1) They were disconnected from a previous call while discussing a payment for March and April, and 2) They needed to be connected with the TV repair department for a non-functioning TV. The agent confirmed the details of the payment and processed it successfully. The agent also provided the caller with a confirmation number and transferred them to the TV repair department for further assistance.

The caller moved to [ADDRESS] and needs to set up their Wi-Fi service at their new address. The agent attempted to locate the caller's account using their new address and telephone number, but was unable to find it. The agent then decided to help the caller set up their service at the new address and asked the caller to stay on the line while they proceeded to get the caller to the right place to get their service set up.

The caller had two issues: 1) an issue with the payment method on their account, they wanted to fix overdue charges, and 2) they wanted to take over the account from their mother, who had moved on, and remove their contact information and information from the account. The agent verified the caller's identity, updated the notification contact information, and processed a payment of $101.25 with the caller's credit card. The agent also updated the autopay method and sent an email for the name change. The caller was able to log in and take care of payments.

The caller's mobile bill was not paid and they wanted to know why it was not drafted out. Additionally, the caller's mobile phone was not working properly and they were unable to access it. The agent verified the caller's account and found that the caller did not have one of their Visa cards set up for autopay. The agent helped the caller set up a new card and processed the payment. The agent also provided the caller with the phone number for Google Pixel manufacturing to help with their phone issue and transferred the caller to a technician to troubleshoot the landline issues.

The caller is moving and wants to know if they need to transfer their internet equipment or get new stuff. The agent verified the caller's account and set up a normal transfer for the caller to connect their equipment to the new location. The agent informed the caller that there is a $30 charge for the transfer, but it will show up on their next bill. The agent also provided the caller with a direct number for internet support in case of any issues.

The caller, Asia, is calling on behalf of [NAME], who is receiving messages stating that there is a down maintenance time for their location. The agent found that the outage was due to a high split upgrade support node activity and was scheduled for [DATE_TIME] today. The agent assured the caller that the outage would be temporary and there would be faster speeds after the upgrade.

The caller, AJ, is assisting another caller with an issue related to a return and new order for 3 devices. The return was due to issues with Verizon activation and the new order was canceled due to a credit issue. The agent suggested that the system may have flagged the order due to the amount of activity and the cancellation was due to credit concerns. The agent planned to call the caller back to continue the conversation.
Good cable service. Occasional disruptions but altogether a good cable and internet service provider

The caller called to set up service but the system did not recognize their phone number. The agent confirmed the caller's service address and phone number, and ran a soft internal credit check. The agent offered two options for setting up the service: a pro install or a self-install. The caller chose the self-install option and the agent arranged for the modem and router to be shipped to the caller on [DATE_TIME]. The agent also informed the caller that they would receive a bill in the mail in about a month.

issue_classification: Billing - Promo Roll Off / Step Up
customer_recount: The caller was having trouble paying their bill through the free system and requested assistance from the agent. The agent waived the usual $5 convenience fee and assisted the caller in finding their account using their full service address. The agent waived the fee, provided the caller with a new card to use, and the payment was successful.

The caller wants to start service with cable, internet, and a home phone. The agent confirmed the caller's address and phone number, and offered a special service called the Select Signature. The caller agreed to the service and the agent sent a text message with the agreements and costs. The agent informed the caller that the equipment will be shipped the next day and provided instructions for setting it up.
the provider offers good internet service but TV service is not all that great most channels repeat. Other channels that I had for free with AT&T were free.

The caller wants to disconnect their cable services due to high costs and stay with the internet. The agent offered the caller a free 12-month subscription and a $30 monthly subscription for two lines. The caller decided to wait until their bill is paid in full with T Mobile to proceed with the offer. The agent locked in the free subscription and informed the caller that they would call back on Sunday to add the other line.

The caller, Agnes, called to inquire about the provider packages and to get information on their current services. The agent gathered information about the caller's location and current services, including their current AT&T and AT&T cell phone services. The agent offered a 3-year price guarantee for the caller to bundle 3 mobile lines and offered a $1000 savings guarantee. The agent also offered to send a text message with the agreement for the services the caller is ordering. The caller was asked to provide their phone number and IMEI number to proceed with the order. The agent also mentioned the possibility of getting a new phone for the caller's daughter.

The caller, [NAME], was having trouble transferring their cellular data or number to a new iPhone 17 Pro. caller had tried to transfer the phone number before but was unable to do so. The agent verified the caller's service address and security code, and instructed the caller to transfer or reset the iPhone. The agent then sent an eSIM to the phone and activated it over Wi-Fi. The caller successfully transferred the data and activated the eSIM. The agent confirmed that the issue was resolved and the caller was able to make a test call.
Great customer service. love my cable

You guys were very helpful when we were signing up after arriving here at Ocean Park. We received help when setting up phones and our TV. One of your techs even stayed past dinner time to make sure our tv was up and connecting with the signal! Thank you!

The caller is unable to access channels 304 and 1304 on their the provider subscription. The agent checked the caller's account and found that the channel is only available for the provider TV Choice 15, which is tied to Fanduel Ohio the provider TV Select and the provider TV Select Plus. The agent also found that the caller has premium streaming, but it has not been activated. The agent sent a link to the caller's phone to help them activate the Peacock streaming app. The agent also offered a $10 credit as a courtesy for the caller's loyalty and offered to transfer the caller to the Internet Repair Retention team. The agent suggested that the caller could speak with the retention team to see if they could lower their bill. The agent also suggested that the caller reset their Roku device.
